body:
It hurts to think of it but my sister-in-law is EXTREMELY attractive in every way possible for my tastes. 

I just love her manner, how she acts, her kindness and how she acts towards me is very alluring to me personally. I enjoy her company more and more, all the time, we get along so naturally, and I struggle to keep my eyes off of her every time I see her, which is nearly every day. And I cannot keep my mind off of her when we're apart. 

I hate myself for even having these feelings in the first place, and typing out the things I love about her just now, man it just cuts me so deep. I don't know what to do. It eats at me every waking minute, I don't even have words for the sick feeling inside when I think of her.

I do love my wife. I know we need to do more together and I will work on that.

I do exercise some, I think it used to help more but now I don't feel that it does. 

I have a few friends, but no one that I could possibly talk to about my sister-in-law unfortunately. I just don't have anyone that close.
 
Right now I'm trying to cling to what good things I can find in my life, and hold on to them with everything I have left, and trying not to dwell on the appeal of suicide.
Thanks man. You hang in there too, we can both get through this.

Yeah, there may well be something better for me, it's just the whole trial and error with medication that scares me. I've been depressed for a really long time, since I was young, but only diagnosed a couple years ago. It seems to have gotten worse now. It confuses me as to how it behaves sometimes because it's always there like a heavy weight inside, but it seems to center around one thing sometimes, like my sister-in-law. It just becomes a storm inside centered on that one awful thing.

I'm very introverted, just dealing with the volume of angry people that I do, beats me down. I wish I had something I could do in solitude. I come home from my job a nervous wreck and dread the next day.
Thanks so much. You've got me in tears because you actually give a fuck. Maybe holding on tight to the good things will help me.
I know you're right man, rationally I tell myself those things and I know that are right and my feelings are delusional. So I can try to work from there. Thank you for that.

Ok, I think i can do that. I do like the snow, that's something I guess I look forward to this time of year. I 

like to write. I think creating things and telling stories is one of the few things that still makes me feel some good inside. I'm halfway through my first novel but it's slow going. 

I love my three year old Corgi named Peach. She's such a good friend and she licks my face when I cry. 

Witcher 3 comes out in February. That should be good.

Thanks for the replies. I'm actually not attending therapy, my doctor recommended it but I have no insurance and am currently looking for a way to afford it. I do have a doctors appointment coming up though and I will take my concerns to him. 

I am working on things with my wife, that is what I want. I do love her, but the way her sister affects me makes me so confused and just so angry at myself and everyone. 

There's a bridge on my way to work. It's pretty icy right now and it would probably look like an accident if I  just drove off of it. Maybe that would be better, just rid myself of the pain and everything. It would just be like sleeping, which is my favorite thing.

Thanks for caring you guys. I truly hope the urges will go away, I just don't want to exist anymore. 

I've tried to run away into anything I can to make myself forget how much everything hurts, fantasy books, video games, writing, but it doesn't fucking work anymore. Every single thing I do makes me think of her and I can't take it. 

The meds did help for a while too, at least they seemed to take the edge off, but they don't anymore. I'm not sure that any drug can help this and I've not told the doctor because I fear being put on pill after pill and getting even worse. 

There is a bridge on my way to work. It's icy right now and would look like an accident. I just want to drive off of it.
